code: library(glyospalettes)  # which companies are covered, and how many palettes each has glyos_companies() table(glyos_colorways$company)  # palette names, optionally for one company or product line glyos_palette_names() glyos_palette_names(company = "TheGodBeast") glyos_palette_names(line = "Battle Tribes")  # the colors of one colorway (prints the swatches and the hex codes) glyos_palette("spectre") #> Glyos colorway 'spectre' (4 colours) #> Onell Design / Glyos: Spectre #> #EEFADA #BCC99B #9EB49A #5FC3A8  # first three colors, a 12-step gradient, or the same gradient dark-to-light glyos_palette("glyaxia", 3) glyos_palette("hades", 12, type = "continuous") glyos_palette("hades", 12, type = "continuous", sort = TRUE)  # swatches with hex codes, for one company at a time glyos_show_palettes(company = "Onell Design") glyos_show_palettes(company = "Spy Monkey Creations", ncol = 2)

text: use One : "categorical" Every pair colors clearly distinguishable (minimum Lab distance 20 ). Good unordered groups. "colorblind" Categorical, still distinguishable simulated deuteranopia, protanopia tritanopia (minimum distance 15 ). "sequential" One hue family (hue spread 45 degrees less among chromatic colors) spanning least 50 units lightness, continuous gradient reads low--high. Pair sort = TRUE glyos_palette() _c scales. "diverging" Exactly two distinct hue families plus light neutral color sit . curated order necessarily dark-, light, dark-B; check glyos_palette_stats() reorder colors continuous diverging scale. thresholds deliberately simple heuristics computed glyos_palette_stats(); treat result shortlist look glyos_show_palettes(), guarantee. company, line Optional filters passed glyos_palette_names(). min_colours Minimum number colors palette must .

title: Get colors from a Glyos colorway — glyos_palette
text: name Palette name. Case-insensitive; see glyos_palette_names(). n Number colors wanted. Defaults every color palette. type Either "discrete" (default) return curated colors , "continuous" interpolate n colors across palette grDevices::colorRampPalette(). strict Logical. discrete palettes, error n exceeds number curated colors (default). FALSE, interpolate n colors instead. sort Logical. TRUE, order colors darkest lightest (CIE lightness) selecting interpolating. Useful palette used sequential gradient; see glyos_find_palettes().

what: Perceptual statistics for every Glyos palette — glyos_palette_stats
title: Perceptual statistics for every Glyos palette — glyos_palette_stats
text: Computes, hex colors alone, suitable palette common plotting jobs. Used glyos_find_palettes(); exposed can apply thresholds.

title: Perceptual statistics for every Glyos palette — glyos_palette_stats
code: glyos_palette_stats(names = glyos_palette_names())

title: Perceptual statistics for every Glyos palette — glyos_palette_stats
text: names Palette names compute . Defaults palettes.

title: Perceptual statistics for every Glyos palette — glyos_palette_stats
text: data frame one row per palette columns: palette Palette name. n_colours Number colors. min_de Smallest pairwise Lab distance two colors. Larger easier tell apart; 20 comfortable floor categorical use. min_de_deutan, min_de_protan, min_de_tritan simulating color-vision deficiency. lum_range Range CIE lightness (0 100) across palette. hue_spread Angular spread chromatic colors' hues, degrees. Near 0 means one hue family. hue_clusters Number distinct hue families (hues separated 60 degrees). has_light Whether palette contains light neutral color can serve midpoint. categorical, colorblind, sequential, diverging Logical flags used glyos_find_palettes().

title: Perceptual statistics for every Glyos palette — glyos_palette_stats
text: Distances CIE76 (Euclidean CIE Lab). Color-vision deficiency simulated Machado, Oliveira Fernandes (2009) matrices full severity deuteranopia, protanopia tritanopia. Hue statistics consider colors chroma least 20, greys blacks count hue.

title: Perceptual statistics for every Glyos palette — glyos_palette_stats
code: s <- glyos_palette_stats() head(s[order(-s$min_de_deutan), c("palette", "min_de", "min_de_deutan")]) #>                  palette   min_de min_de_deutan #> 86       osm_alpha_phase 68.70507      49.76224 #> 76           rf_sentinel 47.62056      48.83391 #> 69 bt_livid_dracosaurian 38.22175      37.96039 #> 74          rf_maxx_zero 40.68568      34.57933 #> 89     osm_jack_asteroid 38.14048      32.93691 #> 90           osm_mystron 33.17829      29.66489

title: Glyos colorway palettes — glyos_palettes
text: named list color palettes, one per colorway, covering Onell Design's Glyos line Glyos-compatible lines partner companies TheGodBeast, Spy Monkey Creations, Toyfinity Four Horsemen. element character vector two six hex colors holding plastic paint colors colorway, ordered first colors distinct one another (body color first, secondary plastic, paint accents). Use glyos_palette() pull colors palette glyos_colorways background colorway, including company made .

title: Glyos colorway palettes — glyos_palettes
code: glyos_palettes

title: Glyos colorway palettes — glyos_palettes
text: named list character vectors hex colors.

title: Glyos colorway palettes — glyos_palettes
text: Hex values approximations. Onell Design palettes sampled reference product photograph Official Glyos Database (https://database.glyos.com/) adjusted Onell's published color descriptions. Partner-company palettes sampled lead photograph figure's page Glyos Wiki (https://glyos.fandom.com/). Clear, glow---dark, metallic pearlescent plastics captured single flat color; palettes reflect plastic photographs.

title: Display Glyos palettes — glyos_show_palettes
text: Draws swatch strip colorway current graphics device, labelled palette name , default, hex code swatch. Useful picking colorway reporting color looks wrong. arguments every palette drawn, lot; filter company, line use narrow .

title: Display Glyos palettes — glyos_show_palettes
code: glyos_show_palettes(   names = NULL,   company = NULL,   line = NULL,   use = NULL,   ncol = 3,   hex = TRUE )

title: Display Glyos palettes — glyos_show_palettes
text: names Optional character vector palette names show. Defaults every palette matching company, line use. company Optional company name restrict ; see glyos_companies(). line Optional product line restrict ; see line column glyos_colorways. use Optional use case restrict ; see glyos_find_palettes(). ncol Number columns arrange swatch strips . hex Logical. Print hex code swatch?

title: Display Glyos palettes — glyos_show_palettes
text: Invisibly, character vector palette names drawn.

what: Glyos colour and fill scales for ggplot2 — scale_glyos
title: Glyos colour and fill scales for ggplot2 — scale_glyos
text: Colour fill scales use Glyos colorway palette. _d variants discrete data, _c variants continuous data, scale_colour_glyos() / scale_fill_glyos() choose two discrete argument. scale_color_* spellings aliases.

title: Glyos colour and fill scales for ggplot2 — scale_glyos
code: scale_colour_glyos_d(palette = "standard", reverse = FALSE, ...)  scale_fill_glyos_d(palette = "standard", reverse = FALSE, ...)  scale_colour_glyos_c(palette = "standard", reverse = FALSE, sort = FALSE, ...)  scale_fill_glyos_c(palette = "standard", reverse = FALSE, sort = FALSE, ...)  scale_colour_glyos(   palette = "standard",   discrete = TRUE,   reverse = FALSE,   sort = FALSE,   ... )  scale_fill_glyos(   palette = "standard",   discrete = TRUE,   reverse = FALSE,   sort = FALSE,   ... )  scale_color_glyos_d(palette = "standard", reverse = FALSE, ...)  scale_color_glyos_c(palette = "standard", reverse = FALSE, sort = FALSE, ...)  scale_color_glyos(   palette = "standard",   discrete = TRUE,   reverse = FALSE,   sort = FALSE,   ... )

title: Glyos colour and fill scales for ggplot2 — scale_glyos
text: palette Name Glyos colorway. See glyos_palette_names(). reverse Logical. Reverse order colors palette? ... Additional arguments passed ggplot2::discrete_scale() (discrete) ggplot2::scale_colour_gradientn() / ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn() (continuous). sort Logical, continuous scales . Order palette darkest lightest building gradient, scale reads low--high. See glyos_find_palettes() palettes suit . discrete Logical. TRUE (default) build discrete scale, otherwise continuous gradient scale.

title: Glyos colour and fill scales for ggplot2 — scale_glyos
text: ggplot2 scale object.

title: Glyos colour and fill scales for ggplot2 — scale_glyos
text: Discrete scales draw first n colors palette, n number levels data. data levels palette colors, palette interpolated grDevices::colorRampPalette() every level still receives distinct color; expect result less legible curated colors.

title: Glyos colour and fill scales for ggplot2 — scale_glyos
code: library(ggplot2)  ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour = class)) +   geom_point(size = 3) +   scale_colour_glyos("glyaxia")   ggplot(diamonds, aes(cut, fill = clarity)) +   geom_bar() +   scale_fill_glyos_d("gatekeeper")   ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +   geom_tile() +   scale_fill_glyos_c("spectre")

New pkgdown site https://bmaitner.github.io/glyospalettes/ filterable palette browser (colors, provenance, reference photos) prefilled GitHub issue forms suggesting palette changes, submitting cleaner photos proposing new colorways.

Studios, NiStuff, Nemo’s Factory, Cappy Space, Banimon, Culture Pirates, October Toys, Zullbeasts, Spaced Design), 193 palettes total. glyos_colorways gains company line columns; wave now character year may NA partner releases. New glyos_find_palettes() glyos_palette_stats() shortlist palettes work categorical, colorblind-safe, sequential diverging use, judged colors . glyos_palette() continuous scales gain sort = TRUE order palette darkest lightest. glyos_show_palettes() prints hex code swatch.
